verdict.rationale: AngelList documents a stakeholder dashboard that shows all of a person's holdings across companies [angellist-docs-16]. Employees can track vesting schedules and option values there [angellist-docs-18], accept grants by e-signature [angellist-docs-17], and admins can preview that dashboard [angellist-docs-32]. That covers the portal, grants and vesting progress, but the evidence never shows strike price or modeling equity value under different exit outcomes, and the update FAQ suggests customers are being moved to other cap table providers. Missing for 10: explicit strike price display, scenario/exit-outcome value modeling, independent or hands-on corroboration of the employee dashboard, clarity on whether the equity product is still offered.
